concept: Step Functions: Lambda orchestration with branching, retries and human approval
tests: Choosing a service to orchestrate several Lambdas with branching logic, retries and manual approval outside function code.
expected: AWS Step Functions — a state machine: Choice, Retry/Catch, wait-for-callback (task token) for human approval. Triggers: "coordinates multiple Lambda functions", "branching", "retries", "human approval", "orchestration out of function code".
why_not: SQS/SNS — messaging primitives without workflow; Lambda destinations only route the result, can't describe a complex multi-step process.
